notes: Annual report of the Playground Commission for 1929-30 (with a review to the end of 1930). Curated: final payments on Potrero Hill and Balboa Terrace, the Funston adult recreation area.

coverage.remaining: Not placed: China Beach, where Senator Phelan's $50,000 bequest was matched by $50,000 of State Park bond money and a November 1930 ballot measure to buy it narrowly failed (no page); Portola Playground's field house fittings; three schoolyards opened (Winfield Scott, Balboa, John Geary).

findings.description: The Playground Commission made the final payment on the Potrero Hill Playground site.

findings.description: Land next to Funston Playground, lent by the Board of Education in 1929, was laid out for adults with bocce and horseshoe courts, putting greens and tables for checkers, plus a large sandbox for children.
